caption:
Eleven women in a UP village turned a local gooseberry into a business - and the Prime Minister named them on national radio.

Kamlesh Kumari has led the Savitri Phule Self-Help Group in Devgarh Kamasi village, Pratapgarh district, Uttar Pradesh, for five years. The 11-woman group processes amla - the gooseberry Pratapgarh is famous for - into candy, murabba and juice, selling through local markets and trade fairs, with a bank loan helping them scale. PM Modi named the group in the 138th episode of Mann Ki Baat on September 27, 2026, highlighting their amla-based enterprise under the One District One Product scheme. Kamlesh Kumari heard the mention on her phone and called it a matter of great pride. Eleven women, one crop and a business built one quintal at a time.
